assign.title: Spend gate: OpenRouter agents are charged what they really cost

action.did: diagnosed+fixed in a worktree: OpenRouter's /v1/messages already returns usage.cost on every response (confirmed live); price() reads it synchronously instead of polling /generation. Added unpriced() + a 3-call gate, and the SERVEX_OPENROUTER_PAUSED check in Agents.spawn(). provider.test.mjs, spend-gate-proof.mjs and the new openrouter-cost-blind-proof.mjs all pass.

experiment.try: real OpenRouter /v1/messages call through Agents.Agent.prototype.price() (the fixed code), cross-checked against /generation (404, never settled) and a before/after key total diff (0 after 28s)
experiment.measure: agent.metered_usd after price() vs the call's own usage.cost field
experiment.result: usage.cost was present and correct on 3/3 real calls (0.000051, 0.00004725, 0.000066); price() set metered_usd to the exact value instantly. /generation 404'd on a fresh id and the key-total diff still read $0 after 28s — reproducing the original incident's blind window exactly, and confirming price() is the only reliable path.

assign.title: OpenRouter cost: price() reads usage.cost, 3 unpriced calls gate, spawn pause added
assign.outcome:
**Fixed: OpenRouter agents' real cost was invisible to the spend limit.** The old path polled `/generation` 6×, swallowing every miss as a silent $0. Confirmed live: OpenRouter's own response already carries the real price on `usage.cost` — no extra request, no delay. `price()` now reads it instantly; the poll stays only as a fallback and logs `unpriced` instead of going quiet, and 3 unpriced calls gate the agent like going over budget.

- [x] fail closed first: `Agents.spawn()` refuses an OpenRouter spawn unless `SERVEX_OPENROUTER_PAUSED=0` — proved against the real merged code in `Servex/agents/openrouter-cost-blind-proof.mjs`
- [x] 3 unpriced calls gate a running agent — same proof file, cases 2–3
- [x] real cause found: `usage.cost` on every OpenRouter response, confirmed with 3 live calls
- [x] fixed by preference order (own response first, `/generation`/key-diff as fallback)
- [x] never silent: `unpriced` spend-gate line + `gate_row().unpriced_calls`
- [x] tests: 8 new (provider.test.mjs ×2, the proof file ×6), 22 pre-existing still pass
- [x] proved live: a real call's `usage.cost` matched exactly what `price()` recorded; the old `/generation` path 404'd and the key-diff read $0 after 28s on the SAME call — reproducing the incident
- [x] pause lifted: `SERVEX_OPENROUTER_PAUSED=0` set, Servex restarted on the new code

Merged 9742e4e2 into `michael/dev`, `--size none` (backend-only, no page touched). Diagnosis and evidence: `Servex/ext/openrouter/gaps.md`, gap 2/3.

Left open: end-to-end confirmation via a real `spawn_agent` call is blocked by an unrelated, pre-existing pool-worktree fault (qf-6/qf-9 held by a stopped agent) — not this task's to fix; the pause gate itself is proven directly against the real code instead.
